name: Captain Vrol

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing high physical damage.

abilities.name: Thunderous Bash
abilities.description: A heavy shield bash that deals very high physical damage and shock damage and stuns if it hits the target. This attack can be blocked.

abilities.name: Frigid Fog
abilities.description: Captain Vrol points his hammer at a target, putting a tracking frost field around that that deals continuous high frost damage to them and nearby allies that stand in the tracking circle.

abilities.name: Shocking Harpoon
abilities.description: Captain Vrol hurls a Sharpened Conduit into the arena floor, which then tethers and pulls multiple targets towards it, while inflicting them with continuous very high shock damage.

abilities.name: Summon
abilities.description: Captain Vrol summons a Storm Twin, a copy of himself that uses the same abilities.

abilities.name: Vrolsworn
abilities.description: During the fight, Vrolsworn Conjurers will appear one at a time on the boat near the arena and summon portals that spawn reinforcements, in the form of Half-Giant Apothecaries, Half-Giant Bulwarks, and Half-Giant Harpooners. The most vital summons are the Bulwarks as they can make Captain Vrol invulnerable when standing near him.

related_quests: The Fight for Kyne's Aegis: Retake Kyne's Aegis from a Vampire Lord's army.
summary: Captain Vrol is a Sea Giant warrior and the second boss of Kyne's Aegis.
